description: Run your Tapfiliate affiliate program: add and approve affiliates and groups, record sales and customers, review and approve commissions, and check what you owe in payments.

tapfiliate_new_affiliate_trigger.description: Runs when an affiliate signs up or is added to Tapfiliate. Records already there when the workflow is turned on don't run it. Tapfiliate is checked on your plan's polling interval.

tapfiliate_new_commission_trigger.description: Runs when a commission is created in Tapfiliate, whether or not it is approved yet. Records already there when the workflow is turned on don't run it. Tapfiliate is checked on your plan's polling interval.

tapfiliate_new_conversion_trigger.description: Runs when a sale is recorded in Tapfiliate, with its amount, commissions, affiliate and customer. Records already there when the workflow is turned on don't run it. Tapfiliate is checked on your plan's polling interval.

tapfiliate_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs when a customer is tracked in Tapfiliate, with the affiliate who referred them. Records already there when the workflow is turned on don't run it. Tapfiliate is checked on your plan's polling interval.
